findings.title: An account push preference is presented as a ready device subscription

originalEvidence.region: ProfilePage push effect and preference toggle
originalEvidence.behavior: Stored push=true, including the default, displays a checked toggle and device-ready copy while currentPushState reports subscribed=false for permission default/granted. The effect read permission but ignored subscribed. currentPushState also swallowed lookup failure into a false unsubscribe state.

findings.disposition: Focused authorized repair completed; root independent review and rendered browser checks pending
findings.repair: Preserve account preference, explain that it applies to subscribed devices, show separate current-browser setup/blocked/unsupported/unknown status, and offer an explicit Enable on this device action plus Check this device again. Do not request permission or modify preference on load. Allow account opt-out when current browser is denied/unsupported. Propagate state lookup failures for honest retry. Missing server configuration no longer says preference was saved before its request succeeds.
